extension.news: The first stable release. FCast protocol v3 throughout: the Initial handshake, PlayUpdate and media events, so a sender's own queue moves on when an item finishes, and playlists the receiver walks itself. Cast photos go to Kodi's picture viewer, downloaded before they are shown. Volume in both directions, and add-on settings of its own. A sender that leaves the network no longer leaves a stream hanging behind it.
